verdict.rationale: Streaming is a fair axis for an LLM gateway, but nothing in the evidence pack documents token-by-token or SSE streaming through Portkey, for any provider. The pack covers a unified multi-provider API, OpenAI SDK compatibility, fallbacks, caching and real-time guardrails. These are adjacent features and do not show that streamed responses pass through the gateway.

support.subject: As a developer, I can stream token-by-token responses through the gateway from any provider
